summary: Reject base continuations that begin with no research effects.
details: The existing normalization module sanitizes base inputs; assembly delegates to it. Empty or absent effects retain a rejected candidate and failed effect gate instead of a paid empty technology. Missing-target and ownership-removal dispositions stay distinct.

Consumed compiler-contract controls check the exact rejection and preserve useful collision, partial ownership and unique-effect behavior. Actual finalizer host controls cover four selected adapters and detect the original empty-input predicate without mutating source proposals.

Controlled structure and graph facts do not qualify native rewards, saved-state migration, multiplayer or performance. Actual packages and upgrade evidence, including any previously generated empty technology, remain required; save and migration acceptance are open.
